scope: 정통사주 17·18회 기본 그림 남녀 4장. 일이 달라진 때와 현재 긴 운을 읽는 공통 장면.
face_policy: 주인공 남성 P14 / 여성 P13 정확한 얼굴과 타로 화풍. 원화는 장면 확인에만 쓰고 생성 참조는 P14/P13만 사용.
source_policy: app/jt-webtoon.js 회별 질문, app/jt-webtoon-2.js 장면·답, app/ssom-vn.html 기본 장면 분기. 새 예언이나 개인 결과를 더하지 않는다.
call_policy: 자산마다 1회 생성. 손 결함이 발견되면 승인된 수정 편집만 별도 기록.

assets.label: 일이 달라진 때 · 예전 작업을 다시 펼치다

assets.scene: The P13 woman revisits her earlier work at a broad table in a quiet illustrator's atelier. An old large portfolio lies open with purely pictorial sketches of objects and places from past projects, no words, numbers or glyphs. Nearby are a worn work apron and a newer closed folio. She has stopped at one page, thinking when her working life began to feel different, with a reflective expression rather than sadness or certainty. Exact P13 face, dark wavy hair loosely gathered behind her shoulders, simple rust-orange dress and cream linen cuffs, no jewels or royal embroidery. One open whole hand rests naturally along the portfolio margin, other rests on her lap, no pen or pinched paper. High diffused window light, charcoal sketches propped against an easel, wooden drawers and soft dust in air. Full head, seated body and table, quiet everyday self-review, no electronics or prophecy symbols.

assets.scene: The P13 woman sits on a low bench in a light-filled attic bedroom with an open old keepsake trunk beside her. On a small vanity before her, a modest painted portrait of her younger self is propped beside a simple oval mirror that subtly reflects her current P13 face. She studies the old portrait with quiet recognition, considering how she has changed over years, not age distress. Current exact P13 face is clearly visible in the foreground, dark wavy hair down, simple lavender-grey dress and ivory shawl, no crown or jewel headdress. Hands rest naturally together on her lap without interlacing or pinching. A folded childhood shawl and a few blank keepsake papers lie inside the trunk. Bright soft morning light, pale timber and linen, understated domestic interior, no calendars, timepieces, dates, text or electronic photographs. One scene; the small painted portrait is an object within it, not a collage.
